name: intents-mcp
description: Your Mac's app actions (Reminders, Calendar, Notes, Writing Tools…) as tools, through Shortcuts. Public APIs only.
long_description: intents-mcp serves the App Intents actions you enable with `intents-mcp enable` (Homebrew CLI) as MCP tools. Each tool runs a signed Shortcut on your Mac; results are read back where possible. Signing uses your iCloud account and Apple receives a copy of each wrapper for validation. No telemetry.
